newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: JOHNNIC, OMNI CANCEL AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: JOHNNIC, OMNI CANCEL AGREEMENT.

text.p: Johnnic Ltd and Omni Media Corporation Ltd on Friday withdrew an earlier cautionary announcement, saying they had cancelled an agreement whereby Omni would acquire Johnnic's 5.5 percent interest in Nethold BV in exchange for Omni shares.

"The agreement entered into between Omni and Johnnic governing the acquisition has, to the extent necessary, been cancelled, and the boards of directors of Omini and Johnnic have resolved not to proceed with the acquisition," the companies said in a joint announcement.
The earlier agreement included Omni proposing to distribute all its shareholding in Times Media Ltd to Omni shareholders.
Friday's announcement added that Omni had decided, for the time being, not to implement the distribution but said this could still take place at some stage.
